g.text: Market Desk | import, compare, save, reopen (J01-J08)
Repository and transaction-manager calls are folded into H2.
redirect; prior catalogue and list kept
The catalogue import has already committed.
Post-import work runs after it so a failure here
never rolls back an accepted import.
insert observations for enabled tracked pairs
read known observations; apply target/drop, quiet hours, snooze
fetch exact product and retailer data
exact product; offers are not calculated
Stop and restart the app. Reuse the H2 file;
read saved items and current prices
Explicit retailer choice persists; unavailable prices remain unknown.
redirect; item added and reminder rescheduled
A closed app never delivers; evaluation runs on page load only.
alert list; quiet hours hold new events
